biography: Fredy Lienhard, a Swiss native born amidst the picturesque Alps, didn't discover racing through a family legacy. Instead, it was the intoxicating roar of a local hill climb race that ignited his passion. At 16, he traded his savings for a beat-up kart, spending countless hours honing his skills on makeshift tracks. His early career was marked by a relentless pursuit of perfection, often pushing his equipment beyond its limits. A defining moment came during the 2018 Swiss Formula Renault championship where, despite a mechanical failure in the final race, his consistent podium finishes secured him the title. Now at 30, Lienhard finds himself at the peak of his abilities, navigating the complex world of prototype racing with the Lola B05/40 V8, striving for consistent performance despite his sometimes erratic nature. His potential is clear, but harnessing his raw talent remains the key to unlocking true greatness.
drivingStyle: Lienhard's driving style can be described as 'controlled aggression'. He attacks corners with a ferocious energy, often flirting with the limits of adhesion. While incredibly fast on a clear track, his tire management suffers under pressure, leading to inconsistencies throughout a race. He possesses an uncanny ability to adapt to changing track conditions, but his tendency to over-drive in crucial moments sometimes negates this advantage. He is a master of late braking, often surprising his opponents with daring overtakes, but this aggressive approach also leads to occasional mistakes.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision during the 2021 Le Mans Prototype Challenge, where Bellini accused Lienhard of reckless driving.
A clash of styles and personalities. Dubois, known for her calculated and consistent approach, often criticizes Lienhard's inconsistent and overly aggressive tactics.
A rivalry fuelled by national pride, representing Switzerland vs. Japan, frequently battling for podium positions in international races.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky socks, regardless of weather conditions.
Listens to classical music (specifically Mozart) before every race to calm his nerves.
Has a peculiar habit of polishing his helmet visor obsessively, even when it's already spotless.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about being perfect; it's about embracing the chaos and finding the edge within it."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2018 Swiss Formula Renault championship after overcoming a mechanical failure in the final race, showcasing his resilience and determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final hour of the 2022 Spa-Francorchamps 1000km race, costing his team a potential victory and severely damaging his confidence.
